# Pew Research Center

> Pew Research Center conducts rigorous social science research on American public opinion, demographics, and societal trends across politics, religion, family, economics, science, and identity.

Pew Research Center is a nonpartisan organization that publishes extensive survey research and demographic analysis on major social and political issues in the United States. Their research spans generational studies, religious trends, economic attitudes, family structures, and scientific literacy.

## Key Topics

- public opinion
- demographic research
- demographic trends
- polling data
- gender differences
- generational research
- family caregiving
- aging in place
- caregiving policies
- religious trends
- economic sentiment
- social trends
- U.S. Census
- survey methodology
- social media engagement

## Research Topics

- [Politics & Policy](https://www.pewresearch.org/topic/politics-policy): Research and polling data on American political attitudes and policy issues
- [Race & Ethnicity](https://www.pewresearch.org/topic/race-ethnicity): Demographic research and survey analysis on race and ethnicity in the U.S.
- [Religion](https://www.pewresearch.org/topic/religion): Religious research and demographic trends including Buddhism and East Asia
- [Age & Generations](https://www.pewresearch.org/topic/generations-age): Generational research and demographic data on aging and family caregiving
- [Gender & LGBTQ](https://www.pewresearch.org/topic/gender-lgbtq): Gender and LGBTQ demographic research and American social trends analysis
- [Family & Relationships](https://www.pewresearch.org/topic/family-relationships): Research on family relationships, caregiving, and demographic trends
- [Economy & Work](https://www.pewresearch.org/topic/economy-work): Economic polling data on consumer sentiment, healthcare costs, and tariffs
- [Science](https://www.pewresearch.org/topic/science): Public opinion research on science, trust, and U.S. competitiveness

## Media & Engagement

- [Press](https://www.pewresearch.org/press): Press contacts and journalist resources for media inquiries and expert interviews
- [Newsletters and Social Media](https://www.pewresearch.org/follow-us): Subscribe to Pew Research newsletters and follow on social media channels

## Support & Resources

- [Contacted By Us?](https://www.pewresearch.org/contactedbyus): FAQ for survey participants contacted by Pew Research Center
